fields.description: (Optional) Predictive scaling policy configuration to use with Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling.

fields.description: (Optional) Estimated time, in seconds, until a newly launched instance will contribute CloudWatch metrics. Without a value, AWS will default to the group's specified cooldown period.

fields.description: (Optional) Whether the scaling policy is enabled or disabled. Default: `true`.

fields.label: Min Adjustment Magnitude
fields.description: (Optional) Minimum value to scale by when `adjustment_type` is set to `PercentChangeInCapacity`.

fields.label: Cooldown
fields.description: (Optional) Amount of time, in seconds, after a scaling activity completes and before the next scaling activity can start.

fields.label: Scaling Adjustment
fields.description: (Optional) Number of instances by which to scale. `adjustment_type` determines the interpretation of this number (e.g., as an absolute number or as a percentage of the existing Auto Scaling group size). A positive increment adds to the current capacity and a negative value removes from the current capacity.

fields.label: Metric Aggregation Type
fields.description: (Optional) Aggregation type for the policy's metrics. Valid values are "Minimum", "Maximum", and "Average". Without a value, AWS will treat the aggregation type as "Average".

fields.description: (Optional) The date and time for the recurring schedule to end, in UTC with the format `"YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ"` (e.g. `"2021-06-01T00:00:00Z"`).

fields.label: Max Size
fields.description: (Optional) The maximum size of the Auto Scaling group. Set to `-1` if you don't want to change the maximum size at the scheduled time. Defaults to `0`.

fields.label: Min Size
fields.description: (Optional) The minimum size of the Auto Scaling group. Set to `-1` if you don't want to change the minimum size at the scheduled time. Defaults to `0`.

fields.label: Recurrence
fields.description: (Optional) The recurring schedule for this action specified using the Unix cron syntax format.

fields.label: Start Time
fields.description: (Optional) The date and time for the recurring schedule to start, in UTC with the format `"YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ"` (e.g. `"2021-06-01T00:00:00Z"`).

fields.label: Time Zone
fields.description: (Optional)  Specifies the time zone for a cron expression. Valid values are the canonical names of the IANA time zones (such as `Etc/GMT+9` or `Pacific/Tahiti`).

fields.label: Expire Date
fields.description: (Optional) Date and time in [RFC3339 format](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc3339#section-5.8) when the mute rule expires. Seconds must be set to `00` (e.g., `2026-12-31T23:59:00Z`). Must not be set when using `at()` expressions.

fields.label: Mute Targets

fields.label: Start Date
fields.description: (Optional) Date and time in [RFC3339 format](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc3339#section-5.8) when the mute rule becomes active. Seconds must be set to `00` (e.g., `2026-01-01T00:00:00Z`). Must not be set when using `at()` expressions.

fields.label: Schedule
fields.description: (Required) Schedule for the mute rule. See [`schedule` block](#schedule) below for details.

fields.label: Duration
fields.description: (Required) Duration of the mute period in [ISO 8601 duration format](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601#Durations) (e.g., `PT4H` for 4 hours).

fields.label: Expression
fields.description: (Required) Schedule expression. Supports `cron()` and `at()` formats. For example, `cron(0 2 * * *)` for daily at 2:00 AM or `at(2026-01-01T00:00)` for a one-time mute. See [Defining alarm mute rules](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/alarm-mute-rules.html#defining-alarm-mute-rules) for details.

fields.label: Timezone
fields.description: (Optional) Timezone for the schedule expression (e.g., `Asia/Tokyo`). Defaults to UTC.

fields.label: Alarm Names
fields.description: (Required) List of alarm names to mute.

fields.label: Region
fields.description: (Optional) Region where this resource will be [managed](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/rande.html#regional-endpoints). Defaults to the Region set in the [provider configuration](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/hashicorp/aws/latest/docs#aws-configuration-reference).

fields.label: Actions Enabled
fields.description: (Optional, Forces new resource) Indicates whether actions should be executed during any changes to the alarm state of the composite alarm. Defaults to `true`.

fields.label: Actions Suppressor
fields.description: (Optional) Actions will be suppressed if the suppressor alarm is in the ALARM state.

fields.label: Alarm
fields.description: (Required) Can be an AlarmName or an ARN from an existing alarm.

fields.label: Extension Period
fields.description: (Required) The maximum time in seconds that the composite alarm waits after suppressor alarm goes out of the `ALARM` state. After this time, the composite alarm performs its actions.

fields.label: Wait Period
fields.description: (Required) The maximum time in seconds that the composite alarm waits for the suppressor alarm to go into the `ALARM` state. After this time, the composite alarm performs its actions.

fields.label: Alarm Actions
fields.description: (Optional) The set of actions to execute when this alarm transitions to the `ALARM` state from any other state. Each action is specified as an ARN. Up to 5 actions are allowed.

fields.label: Alarm Description
fields.description: (Optional) The description for the composite alarm.

fields.label: Alarm Name
fields.description: (Required) The name for the composite alarm. This name must be unique within the region.

fields.label: Alarm Rule
fields.description: (Required) Expression that specifies which other alarms are to be evaluated to determine this composite alarm's state. For syntax, see [Creating a Composite Alarm](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/Create_Composite_Alarm.html). The maximum length is 10240 characters. Leading and trailing whitespace are not allowed.

fields.label: Insufficient Data Actions
fields.description: (Optional) The set of actions to execute when this alarm transitions to the `INSUFFICIENT_DATA` state from any other state. Each action is specified as an ARN. Up to 5 actions are allowed.

fields.label: Ok Actions
fields.description: (Optional) The set of actions to execute when this alarm transitions to an `OK` state from any other state. Each action is specified as an ARN. Up to 5 actions are allowed.

Secret values are stored and managed by AWS Secrets Manager. A maximum of 1 are allowed. Documented below.

Can only be used on the default event bus. For more information, refer to the AWS documentation [Schedule Expressions for Rules](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/events/ScheduledEvents.html).

fields.label: Event Bus Name

fields.label: Event Pattern

See full documentation of [Events and Event Patterns in EventBridge](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eventbridge-and-event-patterns.html) for details. **Note**: The event pattern size is 2048 by default but it is adjustable up to 4096 characters by submitting a service quota increase request. See [Amazon EventBridge quotas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-quota.html) for details.

fields.label: Scope

fields.label: Region
fields.description: (Optional) Region where this resource will be [managed](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/rande.html#regional-endpoints). Defaults to the Region set in the [provider configuration](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/hashicorp/aws/latest/docs#aws-configuration-reference).

fields.label: Log Group Arn List
fields.description: (Required) Array containing the ARN of the log group that this anomaly detector will watch. You can specify only one log group ARN.

fields.label: Anomaly Visibility Time
fields.description: (Optional) Number of days to have visibility on an anomaly. After this time period has elapsed for an anomaly, it will be automatically baselined and the anomaly detector will treat new occurrences of a similar anomaly as normal. Therefore, if you do not correct the cause of an anomaly during the time period specified in `anomaly_visibility_time`, it will be considered normal going forward and will not be detected as an anomaly. Valid Range: Minimum value of 7. Maximum value of 90.

fields.label: Detector Name
fields.description: (Optional) Name for this anomaly detector.

fields.label: Evaluation Frequency
fields.description: (Optional) Specifies how often the anomaly detector is to run and look for anomalies. Set this value according to the frequency that the log group receives new logs. For example, if the log group receives new log events every 10 minutes, then 15 minutes might be a good setting for `evaluation_frequency`. Valid Values: `ONE_MIN | FIVE_MIN | TEN_MIN | FIFTEEN_MIN | THIRTY_MIN | ONE_HOUR`.

For Aurora MySQL, RDS for MariaDB, and RDS for MySQL databases, specify `MYSQL`. For Aurora PostgreSQL and RDS for PostgreSQL databases, specify `POSTGRESQL`. For RDS for Microsoft SQL Server, specify `SQLSERVER`. Valid values are `MYSQL`, `POSTGRESQL`, and `SQLSERVER`.

fields.description: (Optional) Number of seconds for a proxy to wait for a connection to become available in the connection pool. Only applies when the proxy has opened its maximum number of connections and all connections are busy with client sessions.

fields.description: (Optional) One or more SQL statements for the proxy to run when opening each new database connection. Typically used with `SET` statements to make sure that each connection has identical settings such as time zone and character set. This setting is empty by default. For multiple statements, use semicolons as the separator. You can also include multiple variables in a single `SET` statement, such as `SET x=1, y=2`.

fields.description: (Optional) Maximum size of the connection pool for each target in a target group. For Aurora MySQL, it is expressed as a percentage of the max_connections setting for the RDS DB instance or Aurora DB cluster used by the target group.

fields.label: Max Idle Connections Percent
fields.description: (Optional) Controls how actively the proxy closes idle database connections in the connection pool. A high value enables the proxy to leave a high percentage of idle connections open. A low value causes the proxy to close idle client connections and return the underlying database connections to the connection pool. For Aurora MySQL, it is expressed as a percentage of the max_connections setting for the RDS DB instance or Aurora DB cluster used by the target group.

fields.label: Session Pinning Filters
fields.description: (Optional) Each item in the list represents a class of SQL operations that normally cause all later statements in a session using a proxy to be pinned to the same underlying database connection. Including an item in the list exempts that class of SQL operations from the pinning behavior. This setting is only supported for MySQL engine family databases. Currently, the only allowed value is `EXCLUDE_VARIABLE_SETS`.

fields.label: Transit Gateway Default Route Table Association
fields.description: (Optional) Boolean whether the VPC Attachment should be associated with the EC2 Transit Gateway association default route table. This cannot be configured or perform drift detection with Resource Access Manager shared EC2 Transit Gateways. Default value: `true`. **Setting this argument to** `false` will cause Terraform to remove the default association if it exists. This argument does not simply “ignore” the association; it actively manages (adds or removes) the association in AWS to match the value in your configuration. Do not attempt to manage the same association with both this resource and `aws_ec2_transit_gateway_route_table_association`, as this will cause perpetual diffs and resource churn. Use conditional logic to ensure only one resource manages the association at a time.

fields.label: Transit Gateway Default Route Table Propagation
fields.description: (Optional) Boolean whether the VPC Attachment should propagate routes with the EC2 Transit Gateway propagation default route table. This cannot be configured or perform drift detection with Resource Access Manager shared EC2 Transit Gateways. Default value: `true`. **Setting this argument to** `false` will cause Terraform to remove the default propagation if it exists. This argument does not simply “ignore” the propagation; it actively manages (adds or removes) the propagation in AWS to match the value in your configuration. Do not attempt to manage the same propagation with both this resource and `aws_ec2_transit_gateway_route_table_propagation`, as this will cause perpetual diffs and resource churn. Use conditional logic to ensure only one resource manages the propagation at a time.

fields.label: Experiment Options

fields.label: Experiment Report Configuration
fields.description: (Optional) Configuration for [experiment reporting](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fis/latest/userguide/experiment-report-configuration.html). See below.

fields.label: Log Configuration
fields.description: (Optional) Configuration for experiment logging. See below.

fields.label: Region
fields.description: (Optional) Region where this resource will be [managed](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/rande.html#regional-endpoints). Defaults to the Region set in the [provider configuration](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/hashicorp/aws/latest/docs#aws-configuration-reference).

fields.label: Target
fields.description: (Optional) Target of an action. See below.

fields.label: Account Targeting
fields.description: (Optional) Account targeting setting for experiment options. Supports `single-account` and `multi-account`.

fields.label: Empty Target Resolution Mode
fields.description: (Optional) Empty target resolution mode for experiment options. Supports `fail` and `skip`.

fields.label: Action Id
fields.description: (Required) ID of the action. To find out what actions are supported see [AWS FIS actions reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fis/latest/userguide/fis-actions-reference.html).

fields.label: State
fields.description: (Required) State of the safety lever. [See below](#state-block).

fields.label: Region
fields.description: (Optional) Region where this resource will be [managed](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/rande.html#regional-endpoints). Defaults to the Region set in the [provider configuration](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/hashicorp/aws/latest/docs#aws-configuration-reference).

fields.label: Reason
fields.description: (Required) Reason for the current status of the safety lever.

fields.label: Status
fields.description: (Required) Status of the safety lever. Valid values: `engaged`, `disengaged`. Engaging the lever immediately stops all running experiments in the account and Region, and prevents new ones from starting.

fields.label: Arn
fields.description: ARN of the safety lever.

Defaults to the Region set in the [provider configuration](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/hashicorp/aws/latest/docs#aws-configuration-reference).

fields.label: Role Arn
fields.description: (Optional) ARN of the IAM Role for the target account.

fields.label: Deliver Cross Account Role
fields.description: (Optional) ARN of the IAM role in the destination account used for cross-account delivery of flow logs.

fields.label: Destination Options
fields.description: (Optional) Destination options for a flow log. More details below.

fields.label: Eni Id

fields.label: Iam Role Arn
fields.description: (Optional) ARN of the IAM role used to post flow logs. Corresponds to `DeliverLogsPermissionArn` in the [AWS API](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/APIReference/API_CreateFlowLogs.html).

fields.label: Log Destination
fields.description: (Optional) ARN of the logging destination.

fields.label: Log Destination Type
fields.description: (Optional) Logging destination type. Valid values: `cloud-watch-logs`, `s3`, `kinesis-data-firehose`. Default: `cloud-watch-logs`.

fields.label: Log Format
fields.description: (Optional) Fields to include in the flow log record. Accepted format example: `"$${interface-id} $${srcaddr} $${dstaddr} $${srcport} $${dstport}"`.

fields.label: Max Aggregation Interval
fields.description: (Optional) Maximum interval of time during which a flow of packets is captured and aggregated into a flow log record. Valid Values: `60` seconds (1 minute) or `600` seconds (10 minutes). Default: `600`. When `transit_gateway_id` or `transit_gateway_attachment_id` is specified, `max_aggregation_interval` *must* be 60 seconds (1 minute).

fields.label: Region
fields.description: (Optional) Region where this resource will be [managed](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/rande.html#regional-endpoints). Defaults to the Region set in the [provider configuration](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/hashicorp/aws/latest/docs#aws-configuration-reference).

fields.label: Regional Nat Gateway Id
fields.description: (Optional) Regional NAT Gateway ID to attach to.

fields.label: Subnet Id
fields.description: (Optional) Subnet ID to attach to.

fields.label: Tag Field Specification
fields.description: (Optional) Tag configuration for the Flow Logs Amazon EC2 Tags feature fields (e.g., `$${instance-tag}`) used in `log_format`. More details below.

fields.label: Account Id
fields.description: (Optional) AWS account ID to associate with AWS Firewall Manager as the AWS Firewall Manager administrator account. This can be an AWS Organizations master account or a member account. Defaults to the current account. Must be configured to perform drift detection.

fields.label: Id
fields.description: AWS account ID of the AWS Firewall Manager administrator account.

fields.label: Delete All Policy Resources
fields.description: (Optional) If true, the request will also perform a clean-up process. Defaults to `true`. More information can be found here [AWS Firewall Manager delete policy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fms/2018-01-01/APIReference/API_DeletePolicy.html)

fields.label: Delete Unused Fm Managed Resources
fields.description: (Optional) If true, Firewall Manager will automatically remove protections from resources that leave the policy scope. Defaults to `false`. More information can be found here [AWS Firewall Manager policy contents](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fms/2018-01-01/APIReference/API_Policy.html)

fields.label: Description
fields.description: (Optional) Description of the AWS Network Firewall firewall policy.

fields.label: Exclude Map
fields.description: (Optional) Map of lists of accounts and OUs to exclude from the policy. See the [`exclude_map`](#exclude_map-block) block.

fields.label: Exclude Resource Tags
fields.description: (Required, Forces new resource) Whether resources with the tags specified in `resource_tags` are excluded from protection. If `true`, tagged resources are not protected by this policy. If `false` and `resource_tags` are populated, resources that contain those tags are protected by this policy.

fields.label: Include Map
fields.description: (Optional) Map of lists of accounts and OUs to include in the policy. See the [`include_map`](#include_map-block) block.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: (Required, Forces new resource) Friendly name of the AWS Firewall Manager Policy.

fields.label: Region
fields.description: (Optional) Region where this resource will be [managed](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/rande.html#regional-endpoints). Defaults to the Region set in the [provider configuration](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/hashicorp/aws/latest/docs#aws-configuration-reference).

fields.label: Remediation Enabled
fields.description: (Optional) Whether the policy is automatically applied to resources that already exist in the account.

fields.label: Resource Set Ids
fields.description: (Optional) Set of resource set IDs associated with the policy.

fields.label: Resource Tag Logical Operator
fields.description: (Optional) Controls how multiple resource tags are combined: with AND, so that a resource must have all tags to be included or excluded, or OR, so that a resource must have at least one tag. The valid values are `AND` and `OR`.

fields.label: Resource Tags
fields.description: (Optional) Map of resource tags that, if present, filter protections on resources based on `exclude_resource_tags`.

fields.label: Region
fields.description: (Optional) Region where this resource will be [managed](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/rande.html#regional-endpoints). Defaults to the Region set in the [provider configuration](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/hashicorp/aws/latest/docs#aws-configuration-reference).

fields.label: Resource Set
fields.description: (Required) Details about the resource set to be created or updated. See [`resource_set` Block](#resource_set-block) below.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: (Required) Descriptive name of the resource set. You can't change the name of a resource set after you create it.

fields.label: Description
fields.description: (Optional) Description of the resource set.

fields.label: Resource Set Status
fields.description: (Optional) Whether the resource set is in or out of the admin's Region scope. Valid values are `ACTIVE` (Admin can manage and delete the resource set) or `OUT_OF_ADMIN_SCOPE` (Admin can view the resource set, but they can't edit or delete the resource set.)

fields.label: Resource Type List
fields.description: (Optional) Resources that can be associated to the resource set. Depending on your setting for max results and the number of resource sets, a single call might not return the full list.

fields.label: Update Token
fields.description: (Optional) Unique identifier for each update to the resource set.

fields.label: Arn
fields.description: ARN of the Resource Set.

fields.label: Id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the resource set. It's returned in the responses to create and list commands. You provide it to operations like update and delete.

fields.label: Last Update Time
fields.description: Last time that the resource set was changed.

fields.label: File System Id
fields.description: (Optional) ID of the file system to back up. Required if backing up Lustre or Windows file systems.

fields.label: Region
fields.description: (Optional) Region where this resource will be [managed](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/rande.html#regional-endpoints). Defaults to the Region set in the [provider configuration](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/hashicorp/aws/latest/docs#aws-configuration-reference).

fields.label: Volume Id
fields.description: (Optional) ID of the volume to back up. Required if backing up a ONTAP Volume.

fields.label: Arn
fields.description: ARN of the backup.

fields.label: Id
fields.description: Identifier of the backup, e.g., `fs-12345678`

fields.label: Kms Key Id
fields.description: ID of the KMS key used to encrypt the backup of the Amazon FSx file system's data at rest.

fields.label: Owner Id
fields.description: AWS account identifier that created the file system.

fields.label: Type
fields.description: Type of the file system backup.

fields.label: Create
fields.description: (Default `10m`)

fields.label: Delete
fields.description: (Default `10m`)

fields.label: Batch Import Meta Data On Create
fields.description: (Optional) Set to true to run an import data repository task to import metadata from the data repository to the file system after the data repository association is created. Defaults to `false`.

fields.label: Data Repository Path
fields.description: (Required) Path to the Amazon S3 data repository that will be linked to the file system. The path must be an S3 bucket s3://myBucket/myPrefix/. This path specifies where in the S3 data repository files will be imported from or exported to. The same S3 bucket cannot be linked more than once to the same file system.

fields.label: Delete Data In Filesystem
fields.description: (Optional) Set to true to delete files from the file system upon deleting this data repository association. Defaults to `false`.

fields.label: File System Id
fields.description: (Required) ID of the Amazon FSx file system to on which to create a data repository association.

fields.label: File System Path
fields.description: (Required) Path on the file system that points to a high-level directory (such as `/ns1/`) or subdirectory (such as `/ns1/subdir/`) that will be mapped 1-1 with `data_repository_path`. The leading forward slash in the name is required. Two data repository associations cannot have overlapping file system paths. For example, if a data repository is associated with file system path `/ns1/`, then you cannot link another data repository with file system path `/ns1/ns2`. This path specifies where in your file system files will be exported from or imported to. This file system directory can be linked to only one Amazon S3 bucket, and no other S3 bucket can be linked to the directory.

fields.label: Imported File Chunk Size
fields.description: (Optional) For files imported from a data repository, this value determines the stripe count and maximum amount of data per file (in MiB) stored on a single physical disk. The maximum number of disks that a single file can be striped across is limited by the total number of disks that make up the file system.

fields.label: Region
fields.description: (Optional) Region where this resource will be [managed](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/rande.html#regional-endpoints). Defaults to the Region set in the [provider configuration](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/hashicorp/aws/latest/docs#aws-configuration-reference).

fields.label: S3
fields.description: (Optional) Configuration for an Amazon S3 data repository linked to an Amazon FSx Lustre file system with a data repository association. This configuration defines which file events (new, changed, or deleted files or directories) are automatically imported from the linked data repository to the file system or automatically exported from the file system to the data repository. See the [`s3` Block](#s3-block) below. Max of 1.

fields.label: Auto Export Policy
fields.description: (Optional) Type of updated objects that are automatically exported from your file system to the linked S3 bucket. See the [`auto_export_policy` Block](#auto_export_policy-block) below.

fields.label: Auto Import Policy
fields.description: (Optional) Type of updated objects that are automatically imported from the linked S3 bucket to your file system. See the [`auto_import_policy` Block](#auto_import_policy-block) below.

fields.label: Events
fields.description: (Optional) List of file event types to automatically export to your linked S3 bucket. Valid values are `NEW`, `CHANGED`, `DELETED`. Max of 3.

fields.label: Arn
fields.description: ARN of the file system.

fields.label: Copy Tags To Data Repository Associations
fields.description: (Optional) Whether to copy tags for the cache to data repository associations. Defaults to `false`.

fields.label: Data Repository Association
fields.description: (Optional) Configurations for up to 8 data repository associations (DRAs) to create during cache creation. All configurations must be of the same data repository type, either all S3 or all NFS. Maximum of 8. See [`data_repository_association` Block](#data_repository_association-block) below.

fields.label: File Cache Type
fields.description: (Required) Type of cache to create. The only supported value is `LUSTRE`.

fields.label: File Cache Type Version
fields.description: (Required) Version for the type of cache to create. The only supported value is `2.12`.

fields.label: Kms Key Id
fields.description: (Optional) ID of the KMS key to use for encrypting data on the cache. Defaults to the Amazon FSx-managed KMS key for your account.

fields.label: Lustre Configuration
fields.description: (Optional) Configuration for the Lustre cache. Required when `file_cache_type` is `LUSTRE`. See [`lustre_configuration` Block](#lustre_configuration-block) below.

fields.label: Region
fields.description: (Optional) Region where this resource will be [managed](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/rande.html#regional-endpoints). Defaults to the Region set in the [provider configuration](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/hashicorp/aws/latest/docs#aws-configuration-reference).

fields.label: Security Group Ids
fields.description: (Optional) IDs of the security groups to apply to all network interfaces created for cache access.

fields.label: Storage Capacity
fields.description: (Required) Storage capacity of the cache in gibibytes (GiB). Valid values are `1200` GiB, `2400` GiB, and increments of `2400` GiB.

fields.label: Subnet Ids
fields.description: (Required) Subnet IDs that the cache is accessible from. You can specify only one subnet ID.

fields.label: Data Repository Path
fields.description: (Required) Path to the S3 or NFS data repository that links to the cache.

fields.label: Data Repository Subdirectories
fields.description: (Optional) NFS exports linked with this data repository association, in the format `/exportpath1`. Configure `data_repository_path` as the domain name of the NFS file system to use this argument. Not supported for S3 data repositories. Maximum of 500.

fields.label: Auto Import Policy
fields.description: (Optional) How Amazon FSx keeps your file and directory listings up to date as you add or modify objects in your linked S3 bucket. see [Auto Import Data Repo](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/LustreGuide/autoimport-data-repo.html) for more details. Only supported on `PERSISTENT_1` deployment types.

fields.label: Automatic Backup Retention Days
fields.description: (Optional) Number of days to retain automatic backups. Setting this to 0 disables automatic backups. You can retain automatic backups for a maximum of 90 days. only valid for `PERSISTENT_1` and `PERSISTENT_2` deployment_type.

fields.label: Backup Id
fields.description: (Optional) ID of the source backup to create the filesystem from.

fields.label: Copy Tags To Backups
fields.description: (Optional) Whether to copy tags for the file system to backups. Applicable for `PERSISTENT_1` and `PERSISTENT_2` deployment_type. The default value is false.

fields.label: Daily Automatic Backup Start Time
fields.description: (Optional) Recurring daily time, in the format HH:MM. HH is the zero-padded hour of the day (0-23), and MM is the zero-padded minute of the hour. For example, 05:00 specifies 5 AM daily. only valid for `PERSISTENT_1` and `PERSISTENT_2` deployment_type. Requires `automatic_backup_retention_days` to be set.

fields.label: Data Compression Type
fields.description: (Optional) Sets the data compression configuration for the file system. Valid values are `LZ4` and `NONE`. Default value is `NONE`. Unsetting this value reverts the compression type back to `NONE`.

fields.label: Deployment Type
fields.description: (Optional) Filesystem deployment type. One of: `SCRATCH_1`, `SCRATCH_2`, `PERSISTENT_1`, `PERSISTENT_2`.

fields.label: Drive Cache Type
fields.description: (Optional) Type of drive cache used by `PERSISTENT_1` filesystems that are provisioned with `HDD` storage_type. Required for `HDD` storage_type, set to either `READ` or `NONE`.

fields.label: Efa Enabled
fields.description: (Optional) Adds support for Elastic Fabric Adapter (EFA) and GPUDirect Storage (GDS) to Lustre. This must be set at creation. If set this cannot be changed and this prevents changes to `per_unit_storage_throughput`. This is only supported when deployment_type is set to `PERSISTENT_2`, `metadata_configuration` is used, and an EFA-enabled security group is attached.

fields.label: Export Path
fields.description: (Optional) S3 URI (with optional prefix) where the root of your Amazon FSx file system is exported. Can only be specified with `import_path` argument and the path must use the same Amazon S3 bucket as specified in `import_path`. Set equal to `import_path` to overwrite files on export. Defaults to `s3://{IMPORT BUCKET}/FSxLustre{CREATION TIMESTAMP}`. Only supported on `PERSISTENT_1` deployment types.

fields.label: File System Type Version
fields.description: (Optional) Sets the Lustre version for the file system. Valid values are `2.10`, `2.12`, and `2.15`. When creating a file system, `2.10` is valid for `SCRATCH_1`, `SCRATCH_2`, and `PERSISTENT_1` deployment types; `2.12` and `2.15` are valid for all deployment types. Changing this value to a higher version triggers an in-place upgrade. Changing to a lower version forces resource replacement (destroy and recreate).

fields.label: Final Backup Tags
fields.description: (Optional) Map of tags to apply to the file system's final backup.

fields.label: Automatic Backup Retention Days
fields.description: (Optional) Number of days to retain automatic backups. Setting this to 0 disables automatic backups. You can retain automatic backups for a maximum of 90 days.

fields.label: Daily Automatic Backup Start Time
fields.description: (Optional) Recurring daily time, in the format HH:MM. HH is the zero-padded hour of the day (0-23), and MM is the zero-padded minute of the hour. For example, 05:00 specifies 5 AM daily. Requires `automatic_backup_retention_days` to be set.

fields.label: Deployment Type
fields.description: (Required) Filesystem deployment type. Supports `MULTI_AZ_1`, `MULTI_AZ_2`, `SINGLE_AZ_1`, and `SINGLE_AZ_2`.

fields.label: Disk Iops Configuration
fields.description: (Optional) SSD IOPS configuration for the Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP file system. See [`disk_iops_configuration`](#disk_iops_configuration-block) below.

fields.label: Endpoint Ip Address Range
fields.description: (Optional) IP address range in which the endpoints to access your file system will be created. By default, Amazon FSx selects an unused IP address range for you from the 198.19.\* range. Note that the 198.19.\* range is also used by AWS services such as WorkSpaces and AppStream 2.0 for their [management network interfaces](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/appstream2/latest/developerguide/management_ports.html).

fields.label: Fsx Admin Password
fields.description: (Optional) ONTAP administrative password for the fsxadmin user that you can use to administer your file system using the ONTAP CLI and REST API.

fields.label: Ha Pairs
fields.description: (Optional) Number of ha_pairs to deploy for the file system. Valid value is 1 for `SINGLE_AZ_1` or `MULTI_AZ_1` and `MULTI_AZ_2`. Valid values are 1 through 12 for `SINGLE_AZ_2`.

fields.label: Kms Key Id
fields.description: (Optional) ARN for the KMS Key to encrypt the file system at rest, Defaults to an AWS managed KMS Key.

fields.label: Network Type
fields.description: (Optional) Network type. Valid values are `IPV4` and `DUAL`. Default value is `IPV4`.

fields.label: Preferred Subnet Id
fields.description: (Required) ID for a subnet. A subnet is a range of IP addresses in your VPC.

fields.label: Region
fields.description: (Optional) Region where this resource will be [managed](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/rande.html#regional-endpoints). Defaults to the Region set in the [provider configuration](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/hashicorp/aws/latest/docs#aws-configuration-reference).

fields.label: Route Table Ids
fields.description: (Optional) VPC route tables in which your file system's endpoints will be created. You should specify all VPC route tables associated with the subnets in which your clients are located. By default, Amazon FSx selects your VPC's default route table.

fields.label: Active Directory Configuration
fields.description: (Optional) Configuration block that Amazon FSx uses to join the FSx ONTAP Storage Virtual Machine(SVM) to your Microsoft Active Directory (AD) directory. Detailed below.

fields.label: File System Id
fields.description: (Required) ID of the Amazon FSx ONTAP File System that this SVM will be created on.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: (Required) Name of the SVM. You can use a maximum of 47 alphanumeric characters, plus the underscore (_) special character.

fields.label: Region
fields.description: (Optional) Region where this resource will be [managed](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/rande.html#regional-endpoints). Defaults to the Region set in the [provider configuration](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/hashicorp/aws/latest/docs#aws-configuration-reference).

fields.label: Root Volume Security Style
fields.description: (Optional) Root volume security style. Valid values are `UNIX`, `NTFS`, and `MIXED`. All volumes created under this SVM will inherit the root security style unless the security style is specified on the volume. Default value is `UNIX`.

fields.label: Svm Admin Password
fields.description: (Optional) Password to use when logging on to the SVM using a secure shell (SSH) connection to the SVM's management endpoint. Doing so enables you to manage the SVM using the NetApp ONTAP CLI or REST API. If you do not specify a password, you can still use the file system's fsxadmin user to manage the SVM.

fields.label: Netbios Name
fields.description: (Optional) NetBIOS name of the Active Directory computer object that will be created for your SVM. This is often the same as the SVM name but can be different. AWS limits to 15 characters because of standard NetBIOS naming limits.

fields.label: Self Managed Active Directory Configuration
fields.description: (Optional) Configuration block that Amazon FSx uses to join the SVM to your self-managed (including on-premises) Microsoft Active Directory (AD) directory. Detailed below.

fields.label: Dns Ips
fields.description: (Required) List of up to three IP addresses of DNS servers or domain controllers in the self-managed AD directory.

fields.label: Domain Name
fields.description: (Required) Fully qualified domain name of the self-managed AD directory. For example, `corp.example.com`.

fields.label: File System Administrators Group
fields.description: (Optional) Name of the domain group whose members are granted administrative privileges for the SVM. The group that you specify must already exist in your domain. Defaults to `Domain Admins`.

fields.label: Organizational Unit Distinguished Name
fields.description: (Optional) Fully qualified distinguished name of the organizational unit within your self-managed AD directory that the Windows File Server instance will join. For example, `OU=FSx,DC=yourdomain,DC=corp,DC=com`. Only accepts OU as the direct parent of the SVM. If none is provided, the SVM is created in the default location of your self-managed AD directory. To learn more, see [RFC 2253](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc2253).

fields.label: Name
fields.description: (Required) Name of the Volume. You can use a maximum of 203 alphanumeric characters, plus the underscore (_) special character.

fields.label: Storage Virtual Machine Id
fields.description: (Required) Storage virtual machine in which to create the volume.

fields.label: Aggregate Configuration
fields.description: (Optional) Aggregate configuration only applies to `FLEXGROUP` volumes. See [`aggregate_configuration` Block] for details.

fields.label: Bypass Snaplock Enterprise Retention
fields.description: (Optional) Whether to allow a SnapLock administrator to delete an FSx for ONTAP SnapLock Enterprise volume with unexpired write once, read many (WORM) files. This configuration must be applied separately before attempting to delete the resource to have the desired behavior. Defaults to `false`.

fields.label: Copy Tags To Backups
fields.description: (Optional) Whether tags for the volume should be copied to backups. This value defaults to `false`.

fields.label: Final Backup Tags
fields.description: (Optional) Map of tags to apply to the volume's final backup.

fields.label: Junction Path
fields.description: (Optional) Location in the storage virtual machine's namespace where the volume is mounted. The junction_path must have a leading forward slash, such as `/vol3`

fields.label: Ontap Volume Type
fields.description: (Optional) Type of volume, valid values are `RW`, `DP`. Default value is `RW`. These can be set by the ONTAP CLI or API. This setting is used as part of migration and replication [Migrating to Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/ONTAPGuide/migrating-fsx-ontap.html)

fields.label: Region
fields.description: (Optional) Region where this resource will be [managed](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/rande.html#regional-endpoints). Defaults to the Region set in the [provider configuration](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/hashicorp/aws/latest/docs#aws-configuration-reference).

fields.label: Security Style
fields.description: (Optional) Volume security style, Valid values are `UNIX`, `NTFS`, and `MIXED`.

fields.label: Size In Bytes
fields.description: (Optional) Size of the volume, in megabytes (MB), that you are creating. Can be used for any size but required for volumes over 2 PB. Either size_in_bytes or size_in_megabytes must be specified. Minimum size for `FLEXGROUP` volumes are 100GiB per constituent.

fields.label: Size In Megabytes
fields.description: (Optional) Size of the volume, in megabytes (MB), that you are creating. Supported when creating volumes under 2 PB. Either size_in_bytes or size_in_megabytes must be specified. Minimum size for `FLEXGROUP` volumes are 100GiB per constituent.

fields.label: Deployment Type
fields.description: (Required) Filesystem deployment type. See the [AWS API documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/APIReference/API_CreateFileSystemOpenZFSConfiguration.html#FSx-Type-CreateFileSystemOpenZFSConfiguration-DeploymentType) for a list of valid values.

fields.label: Subnet Ids
fields.description: (Required) List of IDs for the subnets that the file system will be accessible from.

fields.label: Throughput Capacity
fields.description: (Required) Throughput (MB/s) of the file system. Valid values depend on `deployment_type`. Must be one of `64`, `128`, `256`, `512`, `1024`, `2048`, `3072`, `4096` for `SINGLE_AZ_1`. Must be one of `160`, `320`, `640`, `1280`, `2560`, `3840`, `5120`, `7680`, `10240` for `SINGLE_AZ_2`.

fields.label: Automatic Backup Retention Days

In these cases, any configured `thumbprint_list` is retained in the configuration but not used for verification. Without a successful `terraform apply` after this parameter is set, this flag will have no effect. If setting this field in the same operation that would require replacing the bucket or destroying the bucket, this flag will not work. The exported value is the ETag generated for the object: an MD5 sum of the object content for plaintext objects or objects encrypted with an AWS-managed key; for objects encrypted with a KMS key or created by the Multipart Upload or Part Copy operations, it is not an MD5 digest. fields.label: Blue Green Update Policy
fields.description: (Optional) Update policy for a blue/green deployment. If this update policy is specified, SageMaker AI creates a new fleet during the deployment while maintaining the old fleet. SageMaker AI flips traffic to the new fleet according to the specified traffic routing configuration. Only one update policy should be used in the deployment configuration. If no update policy is specified, SageMaker AI uses a blue/green deployment strategy with all at once traffic shifting by default. See [Blue Green Update Config](#blue-green-update-config).

fields.label: Auto Rollback Configuration
fields.description: (Optional) Automatic rollback configuration for handling endpoint deployment failures and recovery. See [Auto Rollback Configuration](#auto-rollback-configuration).

fields.description: (Optional) Specifies a rolling deployment strategy for updating a SageMaker AI endpoint. See [Rolling Update Policy](#rolling-update-policy).

fields.label: Traffic Routing Configuration
fields.description: (Required) Defines the traffic routing strategy to shift traffic from the old fleet to the new fleet during an endpoint deployment. See [Traffic Routing Configuration](#traffic-routing-configuration).

fields.label: Maximum Execution Timeout In Seconds
fields.description: (Optional) Maximum execution timeout for the deployment. Note that the timeout value should be larger than the total waiting time specified in `termination_wait_in_seconds` and `wait_interval_in_seconds`. Valid values are between `600` and `14400`.

fields.label: Termination Wait In Seconds
fields.description: (Optional) Additional waiting time in seconds after the completion of an endpoint deployment before terminating the old endpoint fleet. Default is `0`. Valid values are between `0` and `3600`.

fields.label: Maximum Batch Size
fields.description: (Required) Batch size for each rolling step to provision capacity and turn on traffic on the new endpoint fleet, and terminate capacity on the old endpoint fleet. Value must be between 5% to 50% of the variant's total instance count. See [Maximum Batch Size](#maximum-batch-size).

fields.label: Rollback Maximum Batch Size
fields.description: (Optional) Batch size for rollback to the old endpoint fleet. Each rolling step to provision capacity and turn on traffic on the old endpoint fleet, and terminate capacity on the new endpoint fleet. If this field is absent, the default value will be set to 100% of total capacity which means to bring up the whole capacity of the old fleet at once during rollback. See [Rollback Maximum Batch Size](#rollback-maximum-batch-size).

The argument `db_storage_type` places restrictions on this argument's minimum value. The following is a list of `db_storage_type` values and the corresponding minimum value for `allocated_storage`: `"InfluxIOIncludedT1": `20`, `"InfluxIOIncludedT2" and `"InfluxIOIncludedT3": `400`. fields.label: Bucket
fields.description: (Optional) Name of the initial InfluxDB bucket. All InfluxDB data is stored in a bucket. A bucket combines the concept of a database and a retention period (the duration of time that each data point persists). A bucket belongs to an organization. Along with `organization`, `username`, and `password`, this argument will be stored in the secret referred to by the `influx_auth_parameters_secret_arn` attribute. This field is forbidden for InfluxDB V3 clusters (when using an InfluxDB V3 DB parameter group).

However, if a cluster already has a value for `db_parameter_group_identifier`, removing `db_parameter_group_identifier` will cause the cluster to be destroyed and recreated.

You can choose between 3 different types of provisioned Influx IOPS included storage according to your workloads requirements: Influx IO Included 3000 IOPS, Influx IO Included 12000 IOPS, Influx IO Included 16000 IOPS. Valid options are: `"InfluxIOIncludedT1"`, `"InfluxIOIncludedT2"`, and `"InfluxIOIncludedT3"`. If you use `"InfluxIOIncludedT2" or "InfluxIOIncludedT3", the minimum value for `allocated_storage` is 400.

fields.label: Failover Mode

fields.label: Instance Tenancy
fields.description: (Optional) Tenancy option for instances launched into the VPC. Default is `default`, which ensures that EC2 instances launched in this VPC use the EC2 instance tenancy attribute specified when the EC2 instance is launched. The only other option is `dedicated`, which ensures that EC2 instances launched in this VPC are run on dedicated tenancy instances regardless of the tenancy attribute specified at launch. This has a dedicated per region fee of $2 per hour, plus an hourly per instance usage fee.

fields.label: Ipv4 Ipam Pool Id
fields.description: (Optional) ID of an IPv4 IPAM pool you want to use for allocating this VPC's CIDR. IPAM is a VPC feature that you can use to automate your IP address management workflows including assigning, tracking, troubleshooting, and auditing IP addresses across AWS Regions and accounts. Using IPAM you can monitor IP address usage throughout your AWS Organization.

fields.description: (Optional) IPv6 CIDR block to request from an IPAM Pool. Can be set explicitly or derived from IPAM using `ipv6_netmask_length`.

fields.description: (Optional) By default when an IPv6 CIDR is assigned to a VPC a default ipv6_cidr_block_network_border_group will be set to the region of the VPC. This can be changed to restrict advertisement of public addresses to specific Network Border Groups such as LocalZones.

If you use long-term addressing for EC2 instances, you can increase the lease time and avoid frequent lease renewal requests. Lease renewal typically occurs when half of the lease time has elapsed.
